tool_suggestions.title: AI Agent Performance Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design a dashboard for monitoring AI agent performance using metrics like resolution rates, satisfaction scores, and escalation frequency.
features: View daily and weekly performance metrics
Filter data by agent, channel, and date
Chart resolution rates vs deflection rates

tool_suggestions.title: Conversation Audit and Feedback Review
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create an audit tool for reviewing and tagging conversation logs to assess AI agent efficiency and user satisfaction.
features: Search and filter conversations by agent or channel
Review conversation transcripts with sentiment analysis

tool_suggestions.title: Knowledge Base Content Editor
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a tool to manage and update knowledge base articles, track version changes, and assess article usage statistics.
features: View usage metrics and most accessed articles
Collaborate with team on article drafts
